fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Two Cards, Two Numbers: Gimel and Zayin", "body": "Garton frames the whole decode around two major Arcana cards he believes dominate this episode: the High Priestess, whose Hebrew letter gimel, spelled out gimel mem lamed, totals 73, and the Lovers, whose letter zayin, spelled out zayin yod nun, totals 67. He points out that 73 is the 21st prime while its reverse, 37, is the 12th, and ties 73 to chokmah, wisdom, and 67 to binah, understanding, the two facing sides of the Tree of Life. Gabe adds that the Thoth Priestess sits in the giver seat of the enneagram, holding Diana's bow rather than a closed scroll."}, {"title": "London 1977 as a Year of Dreams", "body": "The opening shot gives a place and a date, and a tabloid booth reading dreams, what do yours say about you, so Garton walks through 1977 in Britain: IRA bombs in the West End on January 29, a bomb factory found on February 4, the debut Clash album in April, the third G7 Downing Street summit on May 7, the May 8 convention on hostile environmental modification, the fake documentary Alternative 3, the August 13 Battle of Lewisham, Never Mind the Bollocks in October, Tolkien's Silmarillion, and the Queen's Silver Jubilee. His argument is that the nostalgia spell hides identical programming."}, {"title": "The Ark Hidden Inside the TVA", "body": "Garton's central claim is a wordplay he says he missed for a whole season. A car outside the theatre carries the plate ARK 158H, and the Hebrew word for Noah's ark, tav bet hey, transliterates as TVA once you allow that bet and vet are one letter. He values it at 407, the same as a word for arrows, and notes the Greek Septuagint form theba equals 37, carrying sanctuary and arcana. He later reads OB working inside a crescent shaped desk on salvation from temporal meltdown, and Miss Minutes' repository as an Ark of the Covenant preserving language forward."}, {"title": "Brad Wolf: Barking, Running and Blackmail", "body": "Hunter X5 returns as movie star Brad Wolf, and Garton reads him through dogs. Zaniac is possessed by a swarm that makes him kill women, which he links to the Yorkshire Ripper's most active year, 1977. Latin lupus is named for running, so Brad runs constantly; his cell number 52 is Caleb, a spy and also the Hebrew for dog; St Christopher and the Etruscan Aita wear dog and wolf heads; barque means ship. The black truck marked Miller and King becomes, in his reading, a blackmailer of kings, with Miller equalling 73 in Hebrew. Gabe reads Brad as the Emperor card."}, {"title": "Shadow Play, Temp Pads and Broken Oaths", "body": "In the final hour the punk rockers turn out to be illusions, which Garton takes as Loki, as the TVA, that is the Tavistock and the TV, manufacturing counterculture, with less is enough graffiti prefiguring you will own nothing. He reads the horned shadows as Plato's cave, noting shadow puppetry fed into cinematography, and reads temp pads as cell phones, section 42 as liber, luna and canis, and Casey's line about trackers as a wink at VPNs. Gabe likens the crowd to ants in a shaken jar and argues professors are no longer professional because the oaths are broken."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The Marvelous DeMystifiers return to continue exploring the vast depth of symbolism in Marvel's Loki television series. Picking up at Season 2, episode 2, called Breaking Brad, we explore the encoding of the High Priestess and Lovers cards of the Major Arcana, the endless gematria riddles hiding in the show, more disclosure of the TVA Tavistock controlled counter-culture creation that supports the "sacred timeline" of modern society, and much more.
